latest_release.name: v0.20.0
latest_release.body:
### Upgrade note

If you attach middleware to the `app` returned by `@unlighthouse/server`, check it against h3 v2. [h3 migration guide](https://h3.dev/migration)

*Upgrade note prepared by Codex.*

###    🐞 Bug Fixes

- Use default JSON import and correct locate typo in debug log JSON modules only provide a default export, so the named version import in the client vite config triggers a Vite native configLoader warning on every build. Default-import p  -  by **Harlan GitHub Agent** in https://github.com/harlan-zw/unlighthouse/issues/458 [<samp>(9a214)</samp>](https://github.com/harlan-zw/unlighthouse/commit/9a2147d6)
- **cli**:
  - Preserve unavailable scores in CSV reports  -  by @MaciejZet in https://github.com/harlan-zw/unlighthouse/issues/451 [<samp>(008a3)</samp>](https://github.com/harlan-zw/unlighthouse/commit/008a34f9)
  - Remove vulnerable extract-zip dependency  -  by @harlan-zw in https://github.com/harlan-zw/unlighthouse/issues/466 [<samp>(7d15a)</samp>](https://github.com/harlan-zw/unlighthouse/commit/7d15a336)
- **client**:
  - Add JSON import attributes to vite config  -  in https://github.com/harlan-zw/unlighthouse/issues/440 [<samp>(59ae7)</samp>](https://github.com/harlan-zw/unlighthouse/commit/59ae7935)
  - Remove cyclic core dev-dependency  -  by **Harlan GitHub Agent** in https://github.com/harlan-zw/unlighthouse/issues/443 [<samp>(6ef3f)</samp>](https://github.com/harlan-zw/unlighthouse/commit/6ef3f7f5)
  - Replace deprecated advancedChunks option  -  by **Harlan GitHub Agent** in https://github.com/harlan-zw/unlighthouse/issues/464 [<samp>(89cdf)</samp>](https://github.com/harlan-zw/unlighthouse/commit/89cdf8bd)
- **core**:
  - Decode HTML entities in crawled hrefs ultrahtml keeps attribute values undecoded, so anchor hrefs containing &amp; were queued as literal routes that no page serves, breaking the live-site e2e on every branch. Decode entities in  -  by **Harlan GitHub Agent** in https://github.com/harlan-zw/unlighthouse/issues/457 [<samp>(d16b1)</samp>](https://github.com/harlan-zw/unlighthouse/commit/d16b1343)
- **skills**:
  - Align metadata with the Agent Skills spec  -  by @harlan-zw in https://github.com/harlan-zw/unlighthouse/issues/442 [<samp>(c3d5c)</samp>](https://github.com/harlan-zw/unlighthouse/commit/c3d5c5f6)
- **test**:
  - Use import.meta.dirname in vitest config  -  by **Harlan GitHub Agent** in https://github.com/harlan-zw/unlighthouse/issues/444 [<samp>(1a954)</samp>](https://github.com/harlan-zw/unlighthouse/commit/1a954cc2)

###    🏎 Performance

- **client**: Split vendor chunks to silence bundle size warning  -  by **Harlan GitHub Agent** in https://github.com/harlan-zw/unlighthouse/issues/441 [<samp>(d4356)</samp>](https://github.com/harlan-zw/unlighthouse/commit/d4356929)

#####     [View changes on GitHub](https://github.com/harlan-zw/unlighthouse/compare/v0.19.1...v0.20.0)

detail.readme:
![unlighthouse - Scan your entire website with Google Lighthouse.](https://repository-images.githubusercontent.com/423079536/c88a81ee-43ec-40fc-a615-1d29bbeaaeb4)

Unlighthouse

[![npm version][npm-version-src]][npm-version-href] [![npm downloads][npm-downloads-src]][npm-downloads-href] [![License][license-src]][license-href]

Unlighthouse scans your entire site using Google Lighthouse,
with a modern UI, minimal config and smart sampling.

View Demo

Made possible by my Sponsor Program 💖
Follow me @harlan_zw 🐦 • Join Discord for help

## Quick Setup Run the following command: ```bash npx unlighthouse --site # or PNPM pnpm dlx unlighthouse --site ``` > [!TIP] > Using an AI agent? Get the unlighthouse Skill on [skilld.dev/gh/harlan-zw/unlighthouse](https://skilld.dev/gh/harlan-zw/unlighthouse). _Requirements: Node >= 22.18.0._ ## Getting Started Install instructions for all integrations can be found on the [docs](https://unlighthouse.dev/) site. Need a hand? Join the [Discord](https://discord.gg/275MBUBvgP) for one-on-one help. ### gitignore Unlighthouse will save your reports in `outputDir`, it's recommended you .gitignore these files. ```shell .unlighthouse ``` #### Debugging If you run into any issues with Unlighthouse, the first step should be to re-run the scan with debugging enabled. ```bash # NPM npx unlighthouse --site unlighthouse.dev --debug # or PNPM pnpm dlx unlighthouse --site unlighthouse.dev --debug ``` ## Docs Integration instructions, Guides, API and config spec can be found on [docs](https://unlighthouse.dev/) site. ## Sponsors
